“With topline data from the Embolden registrational trial expected in the second half of 2027, we are progressing key BLA and commercial-readiness activities, including PPQ runs that we believe remain on track for completion this year.

Together, these efforts are aimed at positioning us for a successful launch, if approved.” Third Quarter 2026 and Recent Highlights NGN-401 Gene Therapy for the Treatment of Rett Syndrome • Anticipate reporting topline data from the Embolden™ registrational trial in the second half of 2027 o As previously announced, the Embolden trial was overenrolled due to strong demand from the Rett syndrome community.

• Presented an encore of the positive long-term Phase 1/2 data, as of the data cutoff date of June 16, 2026, at the 55 th Child Neurology Society Annual Meeting o Phase 1/2 data demonstrated developmental milestones were gained in a progressive, stepwise sequence, suggesting a restart of development post-treatment • Presented data at the European Society of Gene and Cell Therapy 2026 Annual Congress that highlighted the key differentiating design elements of NGN-401 for Rett syndrome: o New preclinical data showed rapid onset of action and durable expression of MeCP2 protein following single-stranded AAV (ssAAV) delivery of the NGN-401 construct; the data provided additional evidence that self-complementary AAV does not offer a meaningful advantage in onset of action in the treatment of Rett syndrome NGN-401 was designed to use ssAAV to accommodate the fully functional, full-length MECP2 transgene rather than a minigene o New in vivo evaluation of transgene regulation technologies demonstrated that miRNA-based auto-regulatory technology was not responsive to endogenous MeCP2 levels on a cell-by-cell basis; the data showed expression in both MeCP2-null and MeCP2-expressing neurons o An encore presentation supported the therapeutic rationale for the intracerebroventricular (ICV) administration of central nervous system (CNS)-targeted gene therapy, including NGN-401; ICV administration is a standard neurosurgical procedure performed thousands of times per year, and preclinical data demonstrated broader CNS biodistribution to brain regions central to Rett syndrome pathophysiology, as compared with intrathecal lumbar administration • Partnered with the International Rett Syndrome Foundation to host a webinar focused on educating the Rett syndrome community about NGN-401 • NGN-401 at the 1E15 vg dose has been generally well-tolerated in the Phase 1/2 trial and Embolden (N=35) as of November 8, 2026 • On track to complete Process Performance Qualification (PPQ) runs by the end of 2026 to support the planned Biologics License Application (BLA) submission Key Anticipated NGN-401 Milestones • Report topline data from Embolden registrational trial in the second half of 2027 • Complete BLA-enabling PPQ runs by year-end 2026 • Continue commercial-readiness activities Upcoming Events • Guggenheim 3rd Annual Healthcare Innovation Conference: Management will participate in a fireside chat at 10:30 a.m.
